errors.text: The critical ordering mediator is misidentified: the target involves enhanced L12 ordering within FCC domains, whereas the hypothesis proposes coalescence into B2 precipitates.
Recovery is attributed to thermal activation of dislocation shearing during deformation rather than reduced L12 ordering and formation of ductile transition zones after higher-temperature aging.
The requested numerical boundary of the embrittlement regime is omitted; the approximately 550–750°C window, 600°C ductility minimum, and 750°C recovery are not specified.

The proposed experiment does not directly falsify grain-boundary embrittlement because it does not require measurement of grain-boundary impurity segregation or demonstrate that cracks initiate at jagged phase-boundary tips rather than grain boundaries.
